title: BengaluruTrafficEvent
description: One SYNTHETIC traffic observation for one road segment over one observation interval. Produced by traffic_generator.py (data_source = synthetic_simulator). Not measured Bengaluru traffic data.

event_id.description: Deterministic unique key: <road_segment_id>_<event local time as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>. Stable across reruns, so it can be used as a MERGE / dedup key.

event_timestamp.description: Start of the observation interval, ISO-8601 in Asia/Kolkata (+05:30), second precision.

area.description: Bengaluru area the segment belongs to.

road_segment_id.description: Road segment key (<area_id>-<nnn>); joins to road_segments.csv.

road_name.description: Road name (denormalised from road_segments). Nullable only in Missing_Field anomalies.

vehicle_count.description: Vehicles that passed the segment during the interval (all lanes, both directions). Never exceeds ceil(capacity_vehicles_per_minute * interval_seconds / 60).

avg_speed_kmph.description: Mean speed over the interval (1 dp). Never exceeds the segment speed limit. 0 only during Road_Closure.

occupancy_pct.description: Share of time a detector is occupied (1 dp), derived from flow, speed and lane count.

congestion_level.description: From congestion_score = 0.5*(1 - avg_speed/speed_limit)*100 + 0.5*occupancy_pct: <25 Low, <45 Moderate, <65 High, else Severe. Road_Closure is always Severe.

weather.description: Simulated area-level weather during the interval.

incident_type.description: Active incident on the segment. Recovery periods after an incident report None but still show residual congestion.

incident_duration_minutes.description: Total duration of the active incident in minutes (same value on every row of that incident); 0 when incident_type is None.

is_weekend.description: True on Saturday and Sunday (local time).

data_source.description: Always synthetic_simulator. Marks every record as simulated.

generated_at.description: Simulated time the sensor emitted the event, ISO-8601 +05:30, millisecond precision. event_timestamp + interval + 0.2-5 s latency; much later for Delayed anomalies.

anomaly_type.description: Deliberately injected data-quality anomaly. None for clean records (the default for every record unless anomaly injection is enabled).

x-partitioning.note: Parquet output is Hive-partitioned (year=YYYY/month=MM/day=DD/area=<name>). Partition columns live in the directory path, not in the files.
